summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to declared purpose
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`, so `setup.mjs` runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated (hex-suffixed identifiers `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, property-name indirection objects hiding URL parts and command names) and downloads the Bun runtime (`bun-v1.3.13`) from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/...` to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then uses that runtime via `execFileSync(<bun>, [<math_init.js>], { cwd: D })` to execute `math_init.js` — a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle shipped inside the tarball. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated with a shuffled string/number constant array and a rotator function (`WV8StW` calling `push`/`shift` on `MmgoCP`), a standard string-array obfuscation used to conceal URLs, filesystem paths, and API calls. The package's declared purpose is LaunchDarkly TypeScript type generation; execution of an opaque obfuscated bundle under an alternate runtime on install has no relation to that purpose. The combination — obfuscated preinstall loader, alternate-runtime execution path that evades Node-based tooling, and an obfuscated opaque payload with cover-story filename (`math_init.js`) — is the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time-RCE fingerprint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
